focus.jtag: The Fed delivered its first hike since 2023 and flagged another in 2026; markets fell on Warsh’s hawkish tone but futures are steadier this morning as oil eases off a 4-month high
focus.jnote: The big scheduled risk is now behind us — but the aftershocks aren’t. The FOMC raised rates 25bp yesterday to 3.75–4.00%, its first hike in three years, in a unanimous vote, and the dot plot showed 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike this year. Stocks reversed from early gains as Chair Warsh said summer inflation readings “do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved,” and the 10-year yield climbed back to ~5%, near a 19-year high. This morning the tape is steadier — equity futures are up ~0.5% as WTI slipped ~3% to ~$102 on word that Saudi Arabia’s damaged pipeline may restart soon and more crude is moving through Hormuz. Gold sits near $4,300. A hawkish-Fed hangover stacked on a 5% 10Y and an unresolved oil shock is not a clean premium-selling setup.

risks: The dot plot & the path, not just the hike — 16 of 18 FOMC officials see at least one more hike in 2026, and Warsh called inflation trends not “meaningfully improved.” Any hawkish follow-through from Fed speakers repriices the whole curve regardless of yesterday’s 25bp itself.
10-year at 5% — the 10Y climbed back to ~5%, near its highest since 2007. A further rate pop hits rate-sensitive and AI/hyperscaler names hardest and compounds pressure on stocks.

Oil & the Strait of Hormuz — WTI eased to ~$102 on hopes Saudi’s East-West pipeline restarts soon, but tankers are still under attack and analysts warn repairs could take weeks. A renewed disruption sends crude and inflation fear vertical.

BoJ Fri 9/18 & BoE today — the Bank of Japan is set to raise rates Friday and the BoE decides today; a global-rates surprise on top of a 5% U.S. 10Y is a cross-market gap risk, not just a domestic one.

Thin single-name liquidity (FPS) — the one boarded name returned no open-interest data, its gap is 2 sessions old and fading toward the low-$30s, and its next-earnings date is unknown. Confirm a real ATM market and the true earnings date before ever attempting a fill.

earnings.intro: The Q2/Q3 season is essentially done and the dominant catalyst was macro: the FOMC hike yesterday (Wed 9/16) and its hawkish dot plot, now being digested alongside a 5% 10-year and an unresolved oil/Hormuz backdrop. With central banks still in motion — BoE today, BoJ Friday — keep every spread clear of the next rate-decision window.
